div.head: Ine 23.3
div.ab: Wealh gafolgylda CXX scll', his sunu C, ðeowne LX, somhwylcne mid fiftig; Weales hyd mid twelfum.
Wealh gafolgelda CXX scill., his sunu C, ðeowne LX, somhwelcne fiftegum; Weales hyd twelfum.
Wealh qui gablum reddit hundtwelfti scillinga (CXX sol.), filius eius C solid., seruus LX solid. somhwylcne L; serui corium XII.
Wealh gafolgelda CXX sciƚƚ, his sunu C, ðeowne LX, somhwelcne fiftegum; Weales hyd twelfum.
A Welsh tax-payer [has a wergild of] 120 shillings, his son 100, a slave [a worth of] 60, some fifty. A Welshman [can redeem his] skin [from a beating with] twelve [shillings].

[The wergeld of] a Welsh taxpayer [is] 120 shillings; of his son 100 shillings. [The amount to be paid for killing] a slave [is normally] 60 [shillings] but in some cases 50 [shillings]. A Welshman may compound for a scourging by the payment of 12 shillings
A Welsh rent-payer [has a wergild of] 120 shillings, his son, 100; a slave [is to be paid for with] 60, some with 50; a Welshman's hide with 12 [shillings].

Ein Wälscher, ein Abgabenzahler [hat] 120 Schill. [Wergeld], dessen Sohn 100; einen Hörigen [bezahle man] mit 60, manchen mit 50; eines [hörigen] Wälschen Haut [die Prügelstrafe kaufe man ab] mit 12 [Schillingen].

A Welshman, a rent-payer, [has] 120 shillings [wergeld], his son 100; a dependant [is to be paid for] with 60, some with 50; a [dependent] Welshman’s hide [the flogging is to be bought off] with 12 [shillings].

note.label: cf.
note.quote: In Æthelberht §16 [L10–11] different ranks of slaves have different worths.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: §32 sets the wergild of a Welshman who owns no property – that is, a hired worker – at 60 shillings.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: It is true that §75 requires the owner of a Welsh slave who has killed an Englishman to pay 60 shillings

div.note: see p. 399, n. 4. Apparently the highest class of Welsh peasant is meant.
i.e. a Welshman must pay this sum to save himself from a flogging.
